name: ssh-box
title: SSH box (Alpine)
summary: An SSH shell into the workload you rented, with your own key and nothing else: no other listening port, no fixed service, no password ever issued. Root, by key only.

ssh_key.note: Your own OpenSSH public key line (ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa, or ecdsa-*). Installed as authorized_keys for root; no password is ever issued.
